definition.admission: exact native close, dates, identity, ALL corporate actions and DTB3; any split, ambiguous unit, duplicate or missing session blocks this reading
definition.cash: rate known at the previous session (FRED lag and staleness rules) / 100 x calendar days in the interval / 360; the discount yield is used as a simple money-market rate, an approximation stated as one
definition.differenceFromReplayV11: cash reinvestment is not the Replay v11 vendor factor P_t/P_(t-1) / (1-D_t/P_(t-1))
definition.execution: only after exact committed owner authorization, scoped hashes, all PRIMARY gates, atomic lock and marker
definition.formula: splitRatio * (P_t + D_t) / P_(t-1); reinvest USD cash dividend at ex-date close; SPY splits MUST be absent
definition.metrics: reuse rp1_c1_us_exposure and its independent validator without changing any metric
definition.sourceGateFailure: UNRESOLVED for this reading only; PRIMARY remains independent
definition.targets: identical frozen PRIMARY targets; cannot enter PRIMARY decision
definition.unit: vendor-declared USD per share; no splits in the full bounded history; not independently issuer certified
definition.vendorSeriesRole: audit/legacy diagnostic only; never used to compute or admit this reading

window.reason: first full month after SPY's listing so both readings share one window; the end is the sealed KR study's analysis end

decision.appliedTo: the PRIMARY reading (net of 1x US costs)
decision.axisBasis: net of 1x repository costs over the full evaluation window
decision.economicReadingRole: reported beside the decision; cannot change it
decision.meaning: a DEVELOPMENT nomination of an architecture for later Market x Industry x Stock integration and prospective receipts; never validation, never production
decision.prospectiveFinalArchitecture: the nominated candidate, otherwise C0 (the control) for both NO_CANDIDATE_NOMINATED_CONTROL_RETAINED and NO_UNAMBIGUOUS_NOMINATION_PARETO_TRADEOFF; all four candidates' multipliers are recorded in every receipt regardless
steps: PARETO: eliminate any candidate dominated by another candidate or by the passive reference
NON-INFERIORITY versus C0, both required: net annualized return >= C0's - 0.50 pp, and |maxDrawdown| <= 1.10 x |C0 maxDrawdown|
MEANINGFUL IMPROVEMENT versus C0, at least one: EFFICIENCY_ROUTE net annualized return >= C0's + 0.50 pp, or PROTECTION_ROUTE |maxDrawdown| <= 0.90 x |C0 maxDrawdown|
exactly one survivor is nominated; none keeps the control; several mutually non-dominated survivors are reported as a Pareto trade-off and none is nominated
decision.tieBreak: NONE: survivors are mutually non-dominated, and ranking them (by return, simplicity or anything else) would silently prefer one hypothesis (fewer false alarms, less lateness, both) over another; every candidate stays in the prospective receipts either way

addedDiagnostics.falseAlarmList: every activation with date, target, H63 forward worst loss and status (FALSE_ALARM / FOLLOWED_BY_LARGE_LOSS / PENDING)

addedDiagnostics.status: descriptive; frozen before any outcome; none enters the decision
addedDiagnostics.upDownMarketGap: per year: sum over passive up days of (passive - candidate) and over passive down days of (candidate - passive); arithmetic

C0.hypothesis: the existing SMA200 + Vol63 overlay: 1.0 / 0.7 / 0.4 by the FAST count; the control, unchanged
C0.name: C0_EXISTING_BASELINE_CONTROL

C1.hypothesis: false alarms fall if a single FAST warning needs SLOW or TRANSITION confirmation; slow or transition stress alone never acts; a severe FAST break (both legs) acts without waiting
C1.name: C1_CONFIRMATION_GATED

C2.hypothesis: lateness falls if SLOW and TRANSITION both adverse step the budget down one level before FAST breaks; slow alone is only an observation; once FAST deteriorates the reduction is stronger
C2.name: C2_PREEMPTIVE_HIERARCHICAL

C3.hypothesis: agreement across independent layers balances early warning against false alarms: one isolated adverse family does nothing, two adverse families 0.7, three 0.4, and a severe FAST break is never diluted by benign slow data
C3.name: C3_MULTI_LAYER_CONSENSUS

model.decisionCadence: calendar week-end XNYS session (a session whose next XNYS session lies in a later week)

differencesFromKr.how: passed as an argument to the identical sampling arithmetic

differencesFromKr.us: buy 8bp / sell 8.3bp from the US cost table

model.endDateInvariance: a state at t is identical whether the data end at t or later (calendar-anchored sampling, known-at-t inputs, past-only percentiles)
model.execution: signal at the decision-date close; trade at the close of the NEXT XNYS session

inheritedFrom.rule: every layer, threshold, window, lag, cadence, multiplier, missing-state rule and candidate mapping table is the sealed KR model's, imported

knownConsequences: the 25% vol63 threshold is the KR constant; US index volatility is lower, so the FAST volatility leg fires less often in the US. It is reported, not adjusted
the TRANSITION percentile is the same VIX history; its weekly sampling dates move from XKRX to XNYS week-ends

FAST.definition: count of adverse legs of the existing overlay: close < mean(last 200 closes); std63(ddof=1) x sqrt(252) > 0.25

SLOW.definition: 1 if 10y-3m > 0 now and its minimum over the trailing 504 sessions was < 0, else 0
SLOW.sampling: calendar month-end XNYS session; carried to later sessions until the next month-end
SLOW.spread: DGS10 - DGS3MO on dates where both legs exist

TRANSITION.expandingHistoryStart: the first weekly XNYS session of the grid (1990-01-01 or later)
TRANSITION.state: past-only expanding percentile of the known VIX level on calendar week-end XNYS sessions >= 0.80

model.missingState: a candidate's multiplier is defined only when every completion of the missing layers it reads gives the same answer; otherwise it HOLDS its previous target (no information, no action), counted per candidate; undefined on the first decision date is refused. Missing is never benign and never maximally adverse.
model.output: equityRiskMultiplier in {1.0, 0.7, 0.4} on the US index exposure; never above 1.0
model.reEntry: MEMORYLESS_STATE_MAPPING: the multiplier is a function of today's observable states only; normal exposure resumes on the first decision date whose state maps to 1.0. No trough, rebound threshold, minimum hold, hysteresis or future information.

structuralSwitches.gating: FAST == 1 reduces only when SLOW or TRANSITION is adverse
structuralSwitches.preemption: SLOW and TRANSITION both adverse step the level down by one (floor 0.4)
